title: Maximum Nesting Depth of the Parentheses
summary: For a valid parentheses string s, determine the deepest level of nesting by counting the maximum number of consecutive opening parentheses before a closing one.
statement: For a valid parentheses string s, determine the deepest level of nesting by counting the maximum number of consecutive opening parentheses before a closing one.
constraints: The expression is valid and has length at most 100.
Return the maximum number of simultaneously open parentheses.
hints: Nesting depth equals the number of unmatched opening parentheses at that position.
Maintain a running balance and maximize it immediately after each opening parenthesis.
Increment on (, update the maximum, and decrement on ).
Validity guarantees the balance represents currently open pairs throughout the scan.
editorial: Validity guarantees the balance represents currently open pairs throughout the scan.

tests.explanation: The deepest section, ((8)/4), has three parentheses open.
No parentheses occur, so the maximum depth is zero.
